audit.why: Mantra costs no skill point, is available from level 1, sits on 40/38/36/34s and is refunded further by Gathering Fire, so her level-6 answer is not a new cooldown she has to find. Inspire (8-10s) plus Focused Resolve blunt the first Purgatory attempt.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claimed 'Karma has no hard-CC ultimate'. Mantra empowers Focused Resolve into a strengthened, extended root, so her ultimate absolutely produces hard CC.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.' Also Focused Resolve is a 675-range tether that only roots if unbroken — the counterplay is distance and line of sight, and blinking in with E (425) keeps you inside it.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten around her real W cooldown (12s flat) and the RW root; report[5].t rewritten to state the tether-break rule and the Mantra extension.

edits.before: Purgatory online: top lane's long brawls now end at YOUR floor. Anyone who all-ins you under a third is volunteering for the totem.
edits.after: Purgatory is online, but Mantra costs no point and returns every 40s, so her Inspire shield and Focused Resolve root answer your first commit.

edits.before: You spike clearly: Karma has no hard-CC ultimate and no escape beyond E, so once R Purgatory is online you can E Ashen Pursuit through her, Q Ritual Nails slow, and W burst her below your execute threshold before her shield out-values it.
edits.after: You spike at 6, but Mantra empowers Focused Resolve into a strengthened, longer root — she does have ult-backed CC. Commit while her W (12s flat) is down: E through her, Q to slow, and burst her under the execute before Inspire out-values it.

edits.before: Track Karma’s Focused Resolve (Tether): The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Focused Resolve (W, 675 range, 12s) only roots if the tether survives — break it with distance or line of sight, and Mantra extends it.

edits.before: The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Only commit once it is down or baited.

edits.after: Karma wins by landing Focused Resolve, winning the Inner Flame range war, and shielding your blink burst with Inspire.
